title: OpenRTB in-page push bid via bid.ext canonical fields on a widget/zone-only imp

source.name: ortbtools In-Page Push dialect contract (bid.ext.title/description/image/icon/url/cta field carrier)
source.notes: Exercises the product's own documented, vendor-neutral In-Page Push field contract and its imp.ext.widget_id/zone_id placement signal (packages/core/format-detect.js detectFeedFormat rule 5), not a third-party IAB spec or a named vendor wire format.

modifications: Wholly original OpenRTB envelope, imp, site, device and bid fields; only the field ROLE NAMES (bid.ext.title/description/image/icon/url/cta) are taken from the dialect's own source comment.
IP uses TEST-NET-1 192.0.2.44; user/site identifiers are clearly synthetic fixture strings; asset/click/tracking URLs use reserved .test hostnames.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor, publisher or advertiser data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; user.id/site.id are synthetic-fixture strings; every asset/click/tracking URL uses a reserved .test hostname.

device.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

ext.title: A quiet harbor at dawn
ext.description: Compare three original travel-planning tools before you book.

specNotes: packages/core/dialects/inpage-push.js: bid.ext carries the creative (title/description/image/icon/url, alias cta) instead of adm/native; claimsBid(bid) is true whenever bid.ext has a title-alias or image-alias, and rules-response.js then skips the base IAB response.bid.payload_missing check for that bid so the dialect's own field checks run instead.

packages/core/format-detect.js detectFeedFormat() rule 5 tags FORMATS.INPAGE from exactly this ext.widget_id/zone_id/format==='inpage' signal, but only for the JSON-feed single-object/array shape (line 443 gates it off whenever the payload is already imp[]/seatbid[]-shaped) — an OpenRTB carrier of the same documented placement signal is never reached by that rule.

Preview pipeline (public/ortbtools.app.js): findAdm() only reads adm/iurl anywhere in the response tree, and findPushMaterial()/isMat() only looks at top-level cpc|price + click_url|link + a creative key — neither ever reads a nested bid.ext card, so a bid whose entire creative lives in bid.ext renders the generic empty state.

OpenRTB object-model requirements require at least one Banner, Video, Audio or Native object. A widget/zone extension alone does not satisfy that baseline requirement; imp.format_required is an expected error under both the IAB baseline and the current response-focused inpage-push dialect. The vendor format-tag/preview gap is separate from this correct diagnostic.
notes: The dialect's own field validation (title/image/click required, icon/description/cta length-checked) is exercised elsewhere by the alias-variant sibling case; this case keeps all fields canonical and well-formed to isolate the imp-shape and format-tag deviations.

preview.limitation: Remote creative assets are blocked by the preview content policy.

knownGap.note: The standard OpenRTB media-object requirement is correctly reported and is not this gap. The remaining expectation concerns recognizing the project-documented in-page vendor signal in an OpenRTB envelope and exposing bid.ext creative content where applicable.
